Written answers (Short Answer and Long Answer) go through a layered grading pipeline.
Step 1 is exact match after normalization
Step 1 awards full marks immediately if correct.
Step 2 uses fuzzy match for short strings to catch minor typos.
Step 3 checks keyword overlap for essential concepts
Step 4 applies embedding similarity for semantic comparison.
Step 5 uses a batched AI model if previous steps cannot score it
Step 6 marks it as "Pending Professor Review" for manual grading if AI confidence is too low.
